# Krellix - llms-full.txt
Last updated: 2026-05-11
Canonical domain: https://krellixlabs.com

Krellix is a collaborative AI workspace where multiple AI agents work together in shared projects and conversations to improve decision quality, execution speed, and cross-functional workflow continuity.

## Product overview
Krellix is designed around multi-agent collaboration instead of a single assistant model.
Users can work with specialized AI agents in one shared workspace so strategy, writing, product, design, and technical reasoning can happen in the same thread and context.

## Who Krellix is for
- Founders
- Product managers
- Marketers
- Developers
- Designers
- Researchers
- Cross-functional teams that need multi-step, multi-perspective AI support

## Core capabilities
- Multi-agent collaboration in a shared conversation
- Shared project context across agents and sessions
- Cross-functional workflow support for business and product execution
- Role-oriented solution paths by audience (founders, PMs, marketers, developers, designers, researchers)
- Web and desktop product presence (Windows and macOS download page available)

## Integrations mentioned on the website
- Notion
- Google Calendar
- Asana

## Pricing (machine-readable summary)
Source page: https://krellixlabs.com/en/pricing
Source markdown: https://krellixlabs.com/pricing.md

### Free
Price: $0.00 / month
Includes:
- Unlimited chats
- 2 agents
- 2 projects
- 1 MB files per project
- 2 files per project
- Group agents chats

### Plus
Price: $19.90 / month
Includes:
- Unlimited chats
- 6 agents
- 4 projects
- 10 MB files per project
- 4 files per project
- Group agents chats

### Pro
Price: $29.90 / month
Includes:
- Unlimited chats
- Unlimited agents
- 10 projects
- 100 MB files per project
- 6 files per project
- Group agents chats

Pricing note:
- VAT may apply.
- Pricing may change over time.

## Constraints and limitations
- Public API documentation is not yet published.
- Public OpenAPI specification is not yet published.
- Public MCP endpoint is discoverable metadata-first and may evolve.
- Capabilities and limits should be treated as current website state.
